# The copy property of each std package (TestStdCopyAgrees; owner,
# 2026-11-12: the standard library gets no special treatment). A line is
# `path<TAB>same`, or `path<TAB>differs<TAB>stage: first reason<TAB>unit`,
# where stage is check, surface or lower and unit names the change that
# removes the reason. The file only moves to same: a differs row may not
# join (stdCopyBaseline).
